row: E33 (GLV note §9.35/§9.37): solver B's pivot selection counted (chain-sparsest-counted), B' (chain-sparsest-inc), B'' (chain-sparsest-est); Stage A (10 curves x 1,000 calls x 7 solvers) and end to end (3 solvers x 10 curves x 2 arms, Karatsuba); evidence directory research/e33_solver_b_pivot_count_20261031. No leaderboard row: E33 claims no improvement across the band.
validator: independent validator subagent (Claude Opus 5.5), not the session that produced E33; this recompute is its own standard-library Rust program (validate_e33.rs: JSON parser and SHA-256 carried over from the E27 validator's validate_e27.rs) and shares no code with examples/e33_tables.rs, examples/e33_checks.rs, experiments/37_solver_b_pivot_count/summary.json or tables.md, none of which it reads

claims_checked.section: §9.37 as corrected by the producer's erratum commits 2e90c88792 (13 figures) and 61c4dfecc8 (a fourteenth), made in place after this validator's interim reports

status_rule: pass only if every check holds, every headline agrees within half a unit of its last printed digit, every recomputed G2.124-G2.133 verdict equals the claimed one and every prose figure lies within the recomputed range

raw_data_artifact_store.note: read from the local copy, whose sha256 equals the manifest's; fetch with tools/artifacts in a fresh clone

limitations: Local container (4 vCPU, shared with two other validators), not isolab-eks: operation counts only; no wall time is compared or claimed.

The in-crate unit tests (e33_counted_pivot_selection_is_bit_identical, e33_counted_echelon_equals_the_uncounted_one) were not executed by the producer or by this validator (a release test build of the library needs about 9 GB; building one was ruled out for this shared container). Their content is covered here by the Stage A per-call identity, the end-to-end identity rules and the validator's own controls through the public API, not by the tests themselves.

B counted's pivot digest is compared with B'' and B' only: the uncounted B emits no digest. Equality of B counted's pivots with B's is supported by equal C, echelon multiplications and phase counts on all 10,000 Stage A calls, by reading both routines at c443138920 (same key, same order, same recount domain), and by the validator's measurement of how often a single second-best pivot changes the phase counts (replay/controls).

S_E25/S_X uses X's schoolbook S constructed as E31 B's schoolbook total re-priced by X's own solve (X total - B counted total, both Karatsuba); the solve is in F_p and does not depend on the F_p4 product, and the B'' identity check shows total - solve is equal between B'' and B counted in every arm.
G2.133 prices E25's and A's lead scans with A counted's (Stage A) or X's own (end to end): the existing solver and E27's records do not emit lead_scan_reads.
